name: Jump Highest Skydive!
desc:
✈️ Check in and pick your landing zone.
🪂 Gear up and board the plane.
☄️ Jump and dodge meteors, jets and lightning on the way down!
🏆 Land perfectly to top the leaderboard.

How high can you score? 👀

llm.loop: check in -> board plane -> jump -> dodge meteors, jets and lightning while falling -> land perfectly for score
llm.objectives: land precisely to top the leaderboard
llm.instructions: pick a landing zone, board the plane, dodge hazards, land perfectly
unique: queue-and-wait plane boarding sold with skip-line products
monetization_signals: kill all / scare all troll products
llm.thumbnails: avatar falling from space toward earth; scared avatars in plane seats with countdown timers
llm.complexity_notes: one plane, fall course with hazards, timers
